archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & INDUSTRIAL SCADA (Deep Obsidian + Tactical Chamfer + Neon Glows)
instructions_to_main_agent: Retain all existing functionality, routes, and data flows. Do NOT redesign from scratch and do NOT remove features.

Elevate the visual experience to an Awwwards/industrial level HMI control room aesthetic: machined metallic bevels, deep obsidian surface depth, crisp neon telemetry, photon plasma energy flows, tactile chrome headers, and micro-grid textures.
Implement the Compact/Detail view toggle for the EnergyFlow component as requested by the user.
Ensure the MPPT nodes clearly reflect the user physical topology: each MPPT (Victron SmartSolar) has exactly 1 PV input string running to Akku.
Every key interactive element and telemetry cell must keep or have robust data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays, floating inspector panels, tooltips, or dropdowns. Always use high-contrast solid/crystal-glass with backdrops.

hierarchy.telemetry_hero: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-mono font-semibold tracking-tight
hierarchy.labels_scada: text-[10px] sm:text-[11px] font-sans font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-white/60

visual_enhancers.chamfered_corners: clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 10px) 0, 100% 10px, 100% 100%, 0 100%) or tactical corner notches
visual_enhancers.scada_screws: Four corner micro-rivets: radial-gradient(circle, #64748B 30%, #0F172A 70%) with 1px border for industrial rack-mount look
visual_enhancers.laser_guide_crosshairs: Delicate SVG reticle marks (+) at coordinate intersections in the SVG EnergyFlow canvas
visual_enhancers.pulse_beacons: Animated CSS status pills with soft outer halo for active inverter and MPPT relays

layout_modes.detail_mode: Shows 6 full device nodes with secondary metrics (V, A, Limit, State, Channel breakdown) and animated telemetry pills along flow lines
layout_modes.compact_mode: Streamlined control room view with condensed node footprints (NODE_W 154, NODE_H 64), primary wattage and active spark halos for high density monitoring

node_card_visual_elevation.bevel_top: 1px metallic silver highlight line with 45% center glow
node_card_visual_elevation.left_indicator_bar: 4px wide rounded status bar colored by active telemetry state with drop-shadow glow
node_card_visual_elevation.corner_accents: Tactical bracket borders (2px top-left and bottom-right L-shaped markers) to give an aerospace SCADA display feel
node_card_visual_elevation.badge_pill: Device interface tag (e.g., '1-STRING DC', 'VENUS-OS', 'AHOY-DTU', 'PRO 3EM') in JetBrains Mono 8px uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

flow_plasma_pipeline.base_glow_track: stroke-width: 8px to 14px, opacity 0.12 - 0.28, matching color with blur effect
flow_plasma_pipeline.core_wire: stroke-width: 2px, stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.18), continuous reference track
flow_plasma_pipeline.plasma_stream: stroke-width: 3.5px, stroke-dasharray: 2 12, animated with dynamic speed flowDurSec (0.5s for 3000W down to 2.2s for idle)
flow_plasma_pipeline.photon_particles: Glowing photon orbs moving along path using SVG animateMotion with staggered delays and drop-shadow halo
flow_plasma_pipeline.flow_pills: Interactive wattage badges floating on flow segment midpoints on hover or in detail mode

inspector_panel.visual_style: Machined dark titanium surface: rgba(6, 11, 24, 0.96) with backdrop-blur-xl, 1px accent-tinted border, and glowing status beacon
inspector_panel.content: Rich telemetry grid: live voltage, live amperage, yield today, inverter throttling/limit, cell temperature, and phase load matrix

kpi_strip_spec.grid: grid grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-6 divide-x divide-y lg:divide-y-0 divide-white/[0.08]

cell_treatment.accent_top_hairline: 2px height gradient from device accent color to transparent with glow filter
cell_treatment.hover_effect: translateY(-1px) with subtle ambient glow boost and white/0.05 background wash
cell_treatment.sparkline: Integrated high-density sparkline with gradient fill under curve and current cursor dot

accessibility_and_motion.respect_reduced_motion: All plasma particle flows, rotating sun rays, and wave transforms must strictly pause or fall back to static dashed lines when .reduce-motion or prefers-reduced-motion is active.
accessibility_and_motion.contrast_compliance: Normal text maintains at least 4.5:1 ratio against dark titanium backgrounds. Telemetry numbers use pure white #FFFFFF or high-luminance neon tints (emerald, amber, cyan).
accessibility_and_motion.test_attributes: Every node card has data-testid='flow-[device]', flow paths have data-testid='flow-path-[id]', view toggle has data-testid='flow-view-toggle', inspector has data-testid='flow-inspector'.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never replace existing mock or real data bindings; keep all API poll loops, props, and calculation logic intact.

Do not use generic SaaS flat cards. Use SCADA / control room aesthetic: machined metallic bevels, deep obsidian surface depth, crisp neon telemetry, photon plasma energy flows, and tactile chrome headers.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or floating panels.
